note: [L] has the level identities (`unnormalized`, `reads`) and an invertible terminal map, so x_r = Z v; invertibility is proved by injectivity on a finite-dimensional space and Z is not exhibited as the product of invertible L_m.

snippet.text:
unnormalized m : r ≤ m → m < N → ∀ v,
    (T.entries m v).density 0 C (H.rep N p m) =
      ((H.S.block m).val : ℂ)^d • (H.levels.clock.op m p).push (H.β N p (m+1))
        ((T.entries (m+1) v).density 0 C (H.rep N p (m+1)))
  reads v : (T.entries r v).x = T.terminal v

proof_context.conclusion: `unnormalized` gives the density at level m as `block m ^ d` times the pushed density at m+1, and `reads` gives x_r(v) = `terminal v`.

snippet.text:
let Q : F.Coeff →ₗ[ℂ] F.Coeff :=
    IsLinearMap.mk' (fun v => (P.inits k v).x) (hp.linear k le_rfl hp.ahead).1
  have hQ : Injective Q := by
    apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
    refine LinearMap.ker_eq_bot'.mpr ?_
    intro v hv
    have hzero (m : ℕ) (hkm : k ≤ m) (hm : m ≤ N) : (P.inits m v).x = 0 := by
      induction m, hkm using Nat.le_induction with
      | base => exact hv
      | succ m hkm ih =>
        have he := (hsteps m hkm hm v).1
        rw [ih (m.le_succ.trans hm)] at he
        apply size_separates F _
        simpa [Labels.Frame.coeffSize] using he
    exact ((hp.outfeet v).1.symm).trans (hzero N hp.ahead le_rfl)
  let T : TransferData F H N p :=
    ⟨P.inits, LinearEquiv.ofBijective Q ⟨hQ, LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mp hQ⟩⟩

proof_context.conclusion: The map `Q : v ↦ x_k(v)` is linear and injective, since a zero at the reference level forces a zero at every level up to the cutoff where x_N = v; hence bijective, and it is the `terminal` equivalence.
